#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdlib>

using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

static vector<ll> a, b, c, d, e;
static int n;

static bool check(int i) {
    ll ai = a[i];
    ll bi = b[i];
    ll ci = c[i];
    ll di = d[i];
    ll ei = e[i];

    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
        if (j == i) continue;
        ll ax = a[j] - ai;
        ll bx = b[j] - bi;
        ll cx = c[j] - ci;
        ll dx = d[j] - di;
        ll ex = e[j] - ei;

        for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
            if (k == i || k == j) continue;
            ll ay = a[k] - ai;
            ll by = b[k] - bi;
            ll cy = c[k] - ci;
            ll dy = d[k] - di;
            ll ey = e[k] - ei;

            if (ax * ay + bx * by + cx * cy + dx * dy + ex * ey > 0) return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << "0\n";
        return 0;
    }

    a.resize(n);
    b.resize(n);
    c.resize(n);
    d.resize(n);
    e.resize(n);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i] >> b[i] >> c[i] >> d[i] >> e[i];
    }

    vector<int> ret;
    ret.reserve(11);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (check(i)) ret.push_back(i + 1);
    }

    cout << ret.size() << "\n";
    for (int x : ret) {
        cout << x << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
